system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes seated in a dressing-gown, leaning forward attentively toward Helen Stoner as she speaks, with Dr. Watson beside him","action":"Holmes shakes his head slowly, listening intently to Helen's account, while Watson watches him closely","setting":"Bedroom in the old chamber of the Stoke Moran manor, plain Victorian furnishings, the west wing under repair","secondaryElements":"Dim oil lamp on a side table casting soft shadows; a window showing the dark plantation of trees beyond the grounds; a pipe resting on a tray","mood":"Tense, restrained and intimate, with a gothic undercurrent of unease and quiet suspense","timeOfDay":"Night, late, with the lamp burning low","composition":"Medium two-shot in lamplight, Holmes and Helen in the foreground with the window and dark trees receding behind them"}
